== Sources and photo search (October 2026) ==
* Wife of [[Chuck Kallenbach]]: Michael A. Stackpole's essay "Visiting Decipher" (September 2000 visit), checked on the Internet Archive copy of 8 June 2025.
* Young Jedi sealed event: Decipher NewsFlash of 14 November 2000 by [[Kevin Reitzel]], checked on the Internet Archive copy of 18 November 2001. The article calls the ten players "Decipherians" but gives no job title for her.
* Photo: no captioned photo of her turned up. Captions checked: [[DecipherCon 1999]] photo pages (all four days) and the [[DecipherCon 2002]] photo pages (83 pages). The [[DecipherCon 2000]] day pages link to single-photo pages that the Internet Archive never captured, so those captions could not be read.
* A 1997 Decipher retailer list shows a "Cheryl" at a hobby shop in Overland, Missouri. That entry gives no surname, so it stays off the article.

== Photographs (identification by Bill Bisco) ==

Identification of the photographs. [[Bill Bisco]] identifies the woman pictured with [[Chuck Kallenbach]] in the two posts announcing his death as Cheryl Kallenbach (27 October 2026). The identification is his; neither post captions her.
* Heimlich Maneuvers, [https://drheimlich.blogspot.com/2025/10/everything-else-will-be-better.html Everything Else Will Be Better] (2 October 2025; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027110653/https://drheimlich.blogspot.com/2025/10/everything-else-will-be-better.html Preserved copy]). The blog's image file is named <code>chuckandcheryl.jpg</code>. Files: [[:File:Chuck and Cheryl Kallenbach (Heimlich Maneuvers).jpg]] (reduced to 768 by 1024) and the lead crop [[:File:Cheryl Kallenbach (Heimlich Maneuvers).jpg]].
* Brian Kallenbach's [https://www.facebook.com/chuckkallenbach/posts/pfbid0pLre6PDCidM22g2p4GnVG59kMMtjqewphJWjEHcxECiDEWcoFgRecUpH4Q8M314Fl death notice] on Chuck's Facebook profile (1 October 2025; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261026115715/https://swccg.com/snapshots/facebook/chuck-kallenbach-death-notice-2025-10-01.html Preserved copy]). The full-size photograph needs a Facebook login, so the files come from the snapshot's screenshot of Kevin Fitzpatrick's share of the post (his text names "Chuck Kallenbach. He, Cheryl and Brian"). Files: [[:File:Chuck and Cheryl Kallenbach (Facebook death notice).jpg]] and the crop [[:File:Cheryl Kallenbach (Facebook death notice).jpg]]. The third person in that photograph is not identified.
* Photographer not stated in either post.
